title: Court outcomes · Where accountability leaks · Jawafdehi Initiative
description: Of the 2,649 CIAA cases the Special Court has decided so far, 39% ended with every defendant acquitted.

title: Appeals · Where accountability leaks · Jawafdehi Initiative
description: When a convicted person appeals, the Supreme Court fully overturns the conviction in 41% of trials; when the government appeals an acquittal, the acquittal is overturned in only 1%.
alt: Jawafdehi Initiative, “Where accountability leaks”, Appeals: Appeals go one way: convictions are often overturned, acquittals almost never. When a convicted person appeals, the Supreme Court fully overturns the conviction in 41% of trials; when the government appeals an acquittal, the acquittal is overturned in only 1%.

title: Method · Where accountability leaks · Jawafdehi Initiative
